analysis_rules.distribution_rule: Report median, mean, quantiles, and tail outcomes; do not rely on means alone.
analysis_rules.phase_boundary: Estimate autonomy-building / neutral / autonomy-eroding regions using paired SUPPORT_ON minus SUPPORT_OFF outcomes; always report Delta I and Delta D alongside Delta(I/D).

description: Maps the sign and magnitude of continued-assistance effects across indigenous constraint severity and balanced support intensity.

engineering_calibration.decision: retain the originally specified developmental rate scale unchanged; do not tune to calibration effect direction or magnitude

hypotheses.H_A1: Continued assistance has heterogeneous effects on terminal indigenous autonomy even when it improves near-term operational capability.
hypotheses.H_A2: The sign of the autonomy effect varies systematically with starting indigenous constraint severity and support intensity.
hypotheses.H_A3: Relative indigenous-service growth versus induced demand growth predicts the autonomy-building/autonomy-eroding boundary better than support intensity alone.
